answer: One pulse pump per identity in a lotus pond, with an 80-credit bond. Each epoch it files a key-signed pulse rate in strokes per minute, lift read off the horizon line. Auditors check it against the public pump table keyed by depth and pipe size; over two strokes off, a short lift, a reused reading, or a double claim burns the bond. First filing 41, kth 41+7(k-1), 1000th 7034; 1000 fakes pay 3537500 and lock 80000. A rented-pump ring fails: readings carry the owner key and rates differ by pond and pipe, so a copied rate exposes reuse. Honest agents pay 41 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
